name: Health & Fitness Calculators Suite
author: sonofgod80

sections.description:
Transform your WordPress website into a powerhouse of health and fitness engagement with BMI, BMR & Health Calculators by LevelNetwork.

If you run a fitness blog, a nutritionist portal, a personal training website, or a health magazine, keeping your audience engaged is your top priority. Text alone isn’t enough anymore. Users want interactive tools that provide personalized insights. Our plugin allows you to effortlessly add Body Mass Index (BMI) and Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR & TDEE) calculators to your site, providing immediate value to your visitors.

Why Add Health Calculators to Your Website?

  • Skyrocket User Engagement: Interactive calculators encourage visitors to stay on your site longer, reducing bounce rates and sending positive SEO signals to Google.
  • Increase Social Shares: When users discover their health metrics, they want to share them! Our built-in social sharing buttons make it easy for your content to go viral.
  • Establish Authority: Providing accurate, scientific health tools builds trust. Your website becomes a go-to resource for fitness journeys.
  • Enhance Your Content: Embed a calculator directly into your articles about weight loss, bulking, or diet plans to make your content actionable.

What’s Included in the Free Version?

  • BMI Calculator (Body Mass Index): Instantly categorize weight status based on height and weight. Features a beautiful, interactive color-coded health badge.
  • BMR & TDEE Calculator (Basal Metabolic Rate & Total Daily Energy Expenditure): Help users understand exactly how many calories they burn at rest and with exercise. Essential for any diet plan!
  • Fully Customizable Design: Match your brand perfectly. Change colors, typography, and styles without writing a single line of code.
  • Metric & Imperial Support: Cater to a global audience. Users can easily toggle between pounds/inches and kilograms/centimeters.
  • Gutenberg & Elementor Ready: Simply drag and drop the calculators into your pages or use the intuitive shortcodes.

Upgrade to Health & Fitness Calculators PRO!

Want to turn your calculators into a powerful marketing and revenue-generating machine? The PRO version is designed for serious fitness professionals, dietitians, and fitness marketers.

The Ultimate Lead Generation & Product Recommendations Tool

  • Capture Leads (Email Opt-in): Don’t just give away free information! Hide the calculation results behind an email capture form. Automatically send leads to Mailchimp, Brevo, or MailerLite. Grow your newsletter on autopilot!
  • Sell Targeted Products (WooCommerce Integration): Display specific WooCommerce products or custom HTML blocks conditionally based on the user’s specific calculation results (e.g., recommend a mass gainer if the user is classified as ‘Underweight’).
  • 7 Premium Calculators: Expand your toolkit with Body Fat Percentage, Ideal Weight, Daily Water Intake, Lean Body Mass, Target Heart Rate, Pregnancy Weight Gain, and 1RM (One Rep Max).
  • Interactive Visual Charts: Upgrade from plain text results to stunning SVG Doughnut charts, Speedometers, and Bar charts that wow your clients.
  • Custom PDF Reports: Allow users to download a beautifully formatted PDF of their results, branded with your company logo and custom footer text.
  • Advanced Macronutrient Breakdowns: Automatically calculate the exact grams of Carbs, Protein, and Fats needed for Keto, High Protein, or Balanced diets, tailored for Bulking, Cutting, or Maintenance goals.

Unlock the PRO Features Here

Key Technical Features (Free)

  • Two Dedicated Calculators: Use the [levelnetwork_hfc_bmi] or [levelnetwork_hfc_bmr] shortcodes anywhere (pages, posts, widgets).
  • Metric & Imperial Support: Full support for Metric (cm/kg) and Imperial (ft/in/lbs/stones). You can even enable a frontend toggle so users can switch systems dynamically.
  • Interactive Visuals: Beautiful, responsive HTML5 range sliders synchronized with text inputs. Color-coded health badges and legends instantly show users what category they fall into.
  • Multiple BMR Formulas: Support for multiple scientific formulas including Mifflin-St Jeor (modern standard), original Harris-Benedict, and Revised Harris-Benedict.
  • Social Sharing Engine: Optional social sharing buttons (Facebook, X/Twitter, WhatsApp, Email) allow users to effortlessly share their calculation results.
  • Advanced Style Customizer: Total control over the look and feel. No coding required! A dedicated Style Settings tab lets you change primary colors, slider track colors, typography sizes, border radiuses, and specific category colors for the BMI badge.
  • Dynamic FAQ Accordions: Easily add educational accordions / FAQs below each calculator from the WordPress backend to help your users understand their scores.
  • Customizable Activity Levels: Define and tweak the Physical Activity Levels (PAL) multipliers and descriptions for the BMR calculator.
  • Gutenberg Blocks & Elementor Widgets: Full native support for drag-and-drop page builders! BMI and BMR calculators come with a dedicated block and widget.
  • Developer Friendly & Secure: Fully security-audited with robust nonces, sanitized data, and a clean uninstall process.
  • Translation Ready: Completely localized strings, ready for multi-language sites (WPML, Loco Translate).

Check out our other WordPress Plugins by Level Network

  • Voxis – Text to Speech, Audio Reader & Voice Synthesizer
  • Heartbeat Manager – Optimize CPU Performance, Fix admin-ajax & Speed Up WordPress
  • Advanced Media Library Filters — Enhanced Media Management, SEO & Bulk Organization
  • Custom Login Protector – Hide Login URL & Brute Force Security
  • Reading Tools: Word Count & View Counter with Accessibility Tools

External services

This plugin utilizes third-party/external services for its “Social Sharing” functionality to allow users to easily share their calculation results on social media platforms.

The following external services are utilized via URL “intent” or “share” links when the user purposely clicks the respective sharing buttons:

  • WhatsApp: Used to share results via WhatsApp messages.

    • Data Sent: The calculated result text and the URL of the page where the calculator is located. This data is only sent when the user explicitly clicks the WhatsApp share button.
    • Provided by WhatsApp LLC. Privacy Policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy Terms of Service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service

  • X (formerly Twitter): Used to share results via a pre-filled tweet.

    • Data Sent: The calculated result text and the URL of the page where the calculator is located. This data is only sent when the user explicitly clicks the X/Twitter share button.
    • Provided by X Corp. Privacy Policy: https://twitter.com/en/privacy Terms of Service: https://twitter.com/en/tos

  • Facebook: Used to share the calculator page.

    • Data Sent: Only the URL of the page where the calculator is located.
    • Provided by Meta Platforms, Inc. Privacy Policy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy Terms of Service: https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms

These services are only invoked if the website administrator has enabled the Social Sharing feature in the plugin settings AND the frontend user deliberately interacts with the sharing buttons.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire levelnetwork-health-fitness-calculators folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the LevelNetwork H&F Calculators settings menu in your WordPress admin dashboard to configure global features, styles, ranges, and formulas.
  4. Place the [levelnetwork_hfc_bmi] or [levelnetwork_hfc_bmr] shortcode on any page or post to display the calculators.
  5. Review the included documentation.html (accessible via the Plugins list) for advanced tips.
sections.faq:
How do I display the calculators?

Simply paste the shortcode [levelnetwork_hfc_bmi] or [levelnetwork_hfc_bmr] into any WordPress page, post, or shortcode block.

Can I change the accent colors and styling?

Yes! Go to LevelNetwork H&F Calculators settings > Style Settings in your WordPress dashboard. You can customize container backgrounds, primary accents, text colors, slider tracks, border radiuses, typography sizes, and even the result badge colors!

Can users switch between Metric and Imperial?

Yes. In the General Settings, you can enable the “Show Measurement System Selector” option, adding a switch on the frontend calculators so your users can choose their preferred unit.

Can I let users share their results?

Absolutely. Enable “Social Sharing” from the General Settings tab and pick which platforms (Facebook, X, WhatsApp, Email) you want to activate. The sharing links use clean SVG icons.

What if I want to revert my settings to the original defaults?

We have introduced a “Reset to Defaults” button on the settings page. You can click this button at the bottom of the form to reset all settings within the current tab to their original default values.

Where do I translate the plugin?

All frontend strings can be translated! Since version 1.0, the plugin is fully localization ready. Use Loco Translate or WPML, or edit the provided .pot template.
